dialogues.speaker: Ruins Investigation Log
dialogues.text: "...Research suggests that the ruins here have an incredibly long history stretching back to time immemorial."

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Investigation Log
dialogues.text: "It seems that this was originally a castle built during wartime. A stronghold where mortals and adepti fought jointly to defend Liyue together. Also, something about... Rex Lapis' "lingju."

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Investigation Log
dialogues.text: "So I didn't understand every last detail. But basically, the ruins are pretty ancient. So I'll wager there's some sort of undiscovered treasure still in there somewhere. And if there used to be adepti here, then who knows; maybe some of their good luck will have rubbed off on it."

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Investigation Log
dialogues.text: "I'd better go investigate. The monsters occupying this territory have overwhelmed me and driven me out a few times already, but I can't exactly give up when there's treasure to be found and still call myself one of the Treasure Hoarders with a straight face. Speaking of monsters, looks like another bunch of hilichurls is headed this way..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Yikes. D'you think the guy who wrote this is okay?
